title: Couple a hose adapter into a cam-and-groove coupler and close both cam arms
instruction: Couple the blue hose adapter to the tank's coupler and close both red cam arms.
context: Tank car, truck and ship loaders couple delivery hoses to tank outlets with cam-and-groove (camlock) couplings: the adapter goes fully home, then both cam arms are closed; an arm that will not close means the adapter is not seated, and a half-coupled hose sprays product when the valve opens (O*NET 53-7121.00 Tank Car, Truck, and Ship Loaders; 53-7072.00 Pump System Operators). Board coupler tasks disconnect; board lever tasks close one lever over a part set from above. Here the insertion is sideways and two cams prove it.
setup: Positions are object centres in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases: x forward (away from the arms), y to the robot's left. Table: wood top, arm bases 61 cm apart (y +30.5 and -30.5) on its near edge; nothing else on it. Tank end wall: grey painted plywood, 2 x 8 x 14 cm tall, fixed, centred at x 36, y -2. Coupler body: dark-grey plastic, 8 x 6.6 x 7.4 cm tall (z 3.7 to 11.1 cm above the table), fixed, x 27 to 35, y -2, with a mouth facing the arms and a 3.8 x 3.8 cm square bore on the axis y -2, 7.5 cm above the table, running 7.3 cm in from the mouth; the side walls are 1.2 cm thick, each with a 4.8 x 2.0 cm slot (x 27.7 to 32.5, centred 7.5 cm up). Two cam arms, red plastic, hinged on vertical pins at x 31.5, y +2.5 and y -6.5 (4.5 cm each side of the bore axis), turning freely about 95 degrees: each is a 1.4 x 7 x 1.4 cm bar with a 2 x 2 x 3 cm tall red grip block at its tip and a 3.4 x 1.4 x 1.4 cm lobe at its hinge end. Both start open, bars pointing straight out sideways (grip blocks at x 31.5, y +9.5 and y -13.5). Swung 90 degrees toward the arms, a bar lies along the body 7 mm clear of it, and its lobe passes through the slot 8 mm into the bore. Hose adapter: free, 100 g, standing on a white pad (8 x 8 x 0.3 cm, fixed) at x 18, y -20: a blue plastic riser 4 x 4 x 9 cm tall, a silver collar 1 x 5 x 4 cm on its front, and a black rubber hose tail 6 x 3 x 3 cm behind it, and a silver square shank 3 x 3 cm, 7 cm long, pointing +x with its axis 2 cm above the riser's base; from the collar the shank is a neck 1.2 cm wide (5.7 cm long), then a full 3 cm wide head 0.7 cm long, then a 2.2 cm square nose 0.6 cm long. The shank has 4 mm clearance per side in the bore; with the collar at the mouth, each lobe lies 5 mm from the neck and 5 mm clear of the head's shoulder. Home, the adapter floats with its riser base 5.5 cm above the table.
scoring: At the end of the run, grippers open and the adapter still. G is the gap between the adapter's collar and the coupler's mouth (ruler). Home: G 5 mm or less, shank tip on the bore axis within 10 mm, riser top within 2.4 cm of plumb (15 degrees). A cam arm is closed when its grip block lies within 7 mm of the coupler body. 1.0: home, both arms closed, for 1 s. 0.75: home, one arm closed. 0.5: home, no arm closed. 0.25: not home, but the shank tip was 3 cm or more into the bore for 1 s. Otherwise 0, including an adapter held up with its underside more than 1 cm above the pad or table and not in the bore. A shank more than 5 mm short stops the lobes at its shoulder, and arms closed first block the bore, so neither scores. The bore is 5.5 cm above the table, so sliding the adapter along it cannot score.
reset_notes: Stand the adapter back on its pad, shank toward the coupler, and swing both cam arms open until their bars point straight out.
fidelity: Approximate. Cam arms are damped rigid hinges with slots cut in the coupler wall so a lobe sweeps freely; the gasket and valve are not modelled. The simulator scores the final step without opening the grippers, so an adapter held in the air outside the bore counts as not placed (bottom over 1 cm above the pad or table).
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (both arms reached the coupler holding the adapter beside it, cams left open); demo: 1.0 (right arm lifted the adapter into the coupler, closed both cams, released and withdrew)
